review_description: Six years ago with had AHE group install out 10 Kilowatt Solar panels and Inverter.  Now with energy prices still rising we opted to get a Solar Battery installed.  We were very happy last time with Andrew and is crew when they installed our Solar system so we had no hesitation in going back to them for the battery installation. Andrew personally discussed with us our requirements and provided us with a battery solution (24kWh Sigenery battery and 10kW inverter) and quote.On the day Andrew came with his crew and personally installed the system to our existing Solar Panels. They discussed with us the best location to install the Battery and Gateway and we were very happy with the final outcome.  Andrew outlined the display features of the battery and helped us with the App setup and capabilities.  Overall with a very happy with AHE group as they are a family company and pride themselves on their work, customer service and getting it right the first time.  We would not hesitate recommending them to anyone looking for Solar installations.

The entire process was seamless. From the initial review, quote process and installation, it was very smooth and met the expectations provided by AHE. They arrived on time, everything was well installed, and they provided an in-depth training on the various apps required. I would recommend them to anyone.

AHE Group suppliedand fitted our first solar panel systemin 2011. We have just had them upgrade our system to an 11.88kw with battery and its brilliant. Their sales and install team are excellent to deal with and I would definitely recommend them.

10 years ago I got the team from AHE to do a solar PV install for me on my new house build.10.5 KW Of LG solar Panels and a 10kw 3 Phase SMA inverter. Couldn’t have been any happier and the system has operated absolutely flawlessly since then.So when the battery rebate kicked in. I called AHE again and asked them to quote me on an appropriate system. I must say the whole process from design, to quoting to install was deadset flawless. Not only does Andrew and the team know their products inside out but they apply real world use for their installs.Ended up with the Sigenergy Sigenstor 48kw system, an increase of 11 kw of panels and the accompanying Sig EV charger.Install was flawless and efficient. Completed in a day with a full rundown of the product along with answering a plethora of my questions. Not to mention the little added extra surprise of the included automation of some external power devices which I had no clue was even possible!I am deadset wrapped with the install and my new shiny battery!Thanks again to Andrew and the team at AHE!

Andrew and the team at AHE have been great right from the quoting stage to installation. I took a while to decide on the installer and AHE were very responsive and helpful throughout the process.They even assisted with my switchboard upgrades for a great price. Showed up time on the day of the install and completed the job without any issues.They explained to me in detail about the installed system and helped me setup the app on my phone.I would highly recommend AHE to anyone looking to install solar and batteries!!

Andrew Hanna gave very detailed advice about where we could install a solar battery in our terrace, and recommended Sigenergy as the best option for the space we had.The install was completed cleanly and effeciently, with attention to detail that everything was working as expected.I used AHE previously to install our solar system years ago, and they have always been flexible and ready to help. I think their longetivity speaks to the quality of the work and the customer service they provide.

Andrew installed my first solar system around 13 years ago. I had no hesitation in asking Andrew to provide a quote for a battery and solar system to replace the original. I found Andrew, Leanne, Donna and team a pleasure to deal with. From requesting a quote to installation was a breeze. Andrew was always available to provide more information when I had questions. On installation day the team arrived around 8 and I was up and running around 3 including a handover before they left. Even though Andrew wasn't able to be on site for the installation he followed up with a phone call to ensure everything was OK.
Altogether professional good communications and could not ask for better service.

Wow…… what a great experience. Andrew, Leanne and their crew knew their stuff. From the initial call through to install, I knew I was in good hands. They gave a very competitive quote and answered all my numerous questions throughout the entire process without any hesitation, annoyance or eye rolling. On the day of install, Andrew and Sam (Andrew’s son)  were able to redistribute the solar panels on the roof to optimise a greater solar yield and even threw in an extra panel free of charge.After the installation was completed, Andrew showed me how to use the app and also went through a blackout scenario to ensure the system was working properly.I live on the NSW Central Coast and was originally going to go with a local installer however, I would not hesitate in recommending AHE group for any solar and battery installation. Their professionalism was next to none. Thank you

Andrew and team installed our first small system in 2011. It's still going strong. Last Thursday they commissioned our 13kW Jinko array with 48kWh Sigen battery. They arrived at 8am, as promised, and it was up and running by 1pm. The guys take great pride in their work and managed to hide all cables (panels to battery, battery to gateway, gateway to board). The panels from 2011 were cleaned off and the old inverter was plugged into the AC input of the gateway and now provides about 1/7 of total generation. I did get another 3 quotes from Solar Quotes but Andrew was given the job not just because we had worked with him before, he was also the cheapest and did not oversell. (In fact he suggested I get a new car before getting a charger.)  Also, great to work with the same person all the way through (avoiding miscommunication). Better clean up than most tradies we've used. Helpful advice too. For example, I plan to move to Amber (without Smartshift) and he suggested playing with the gateway's various "modes" and get to know these before moving. I have since discovered I can also create my own modes!

Andrew inspected our premises and reviewed our electricity bills before providing a quote for a tailored, recommended package. The quote was slightly higher than the next one, but in-house tradesmen installation was perceived to be less risky.The date was set, was met and the installation by Sam and Anthony was efficient and clean. The battery was already 40% full on activation at 1:00pm and 87% in four hours.Our first night was like heaven! Lights, fridge, everything run from the sun and not the grid. What a great result!AHE was recommended to us by our sparkie, and I can recommend them to you.
It is very helpful and reliable for service that provided by AHE

The quoting process was straight forward. I asked Andrew I wanted an Enphase system and to put as much panels in the northern roof. Other installers were very hesitant due to the roof design. Andrew said he would try and everything worked out.The installation went very well. Not one roof tile was broken and the system works and performs very well with close to 60kWh energy production on a good sunny day with a 10kW system. The team was very professional.The customer service was excellent. Leeanne and Andrew got back to me very quickly with all my questions. Also they helped me setup the Enphase app to monitor the power and energy production.

Andrew visited the site before the installation.He advised us on an optimal solution by removing the existing and aging solar System.We decided to take up his advice and upsize the new system that includes the 10 years warranty.The additional work to remove the old bore pump control panel and carry out electrical field wiring to the new bore pump panel was carried out as part of the project at the same time.The installation was carried out over two days.The workmanship and attention to details was of a high standard.We just found out AHE Group was a runner up in the top rated Installers in NSW 2025 by Solar QuotesCongratulations

I had my SIGENERGY battery installed by AHE Group and it was a great experience from start to finish. The installers were polite, experienced, and took the time to explain everything clearly. They found the right solution for me and finished the job ahead of schedule. The whole process was smooth and stress-free, and I’m very happy with the result. Would definitely recommend AHE Group to anyone thinking about solar or battery storage.

The AHE Solar Group recommended and installed our Sigenergy battery system.They did a fantastic job.Being a builder I'm very particular but I could not fault their workmanship, punctuality or competitive pricing.Truly Andrew is a Sunshine Superman and Leannes' organisation first class. Highly recommended.

Had my Tesla solar system installed by Andrew, his son and nephew — an awesome family team! From the first visit to check out my place to the final install, everything was smooth and professional. Andrew took the time to explain the options and gave a practical plan that really suited my home.The install was done in just one day, super tidy job and great attention to detail. Also showed me how to monitor the usage on app. It’s been about three months now and my power bills have dropped heaps. Couldn’t be happier — highly recommend these guys if you’re thinking about going solar!
From start to finish we were happy with the service Andrew provided. Great value and efficient install.
Andrew was upfront and honest with the plan for my job and asked what I wanted from my system. Andrew and his team were friendly and punctual, with a neat and tidy solar and battery install.

The sales process with AHE was relaxed and pressure-free. Andrew, the owner, took the time to clearly explain everything, and when I started asking trickier questions he personally came over assessed the house and offered an innovative solution I hadn’t considered.Installation was smooth and efficient, thanks to a highly skilled and well-coordinated team. Their expertise, experience and teamwork were evident, it looked like they have been doing this every day for years. I appreciated that they rely on family members and trusted contractors rather than sub-contracting the work. This means you’re always getting the ‘A’ team for your installation, not just a lucky dip. While this approach could mean waiting a little longer for installation (I only waited less than a month), I think knowing what quality you are going to get is worthwhile.As a former architect, I also appreciate that AHE is meticulous with paperwork—quotes, contracts, and certifications are all handled thoroughly and building standards are strictly adhered to with no corners cut.Overall, AHE delivers professional, high-quality service with a personal touch. I highly recommend them.

Great working with Leeanne, Andrew and the team. This is the second install on a different property in the last 10 years, and still an amazing team.Work was very professional, punctual and no mess left onsite. Andrew is a pleasure to deal, well done

It was pleasure to work with Andrew and his team.The quote was comprehensive and thorough. Several revisions with several options were offered. Onsite inspection was important part of choosing the most appropriate option and allowed to ask questions / discuss installation/ positioning of the battery, panels, etc.Installation was completed on scheduled day by 3pm. Punctual. No nonsense. Arrived prepared and with sufficient resources.Excellent installation quality - no visible cabling. All equipment looks like it was meant to be there.

I had my first solar installation years ago with this group and was very satisfied with them. When I started looking for installers this year, AHE Group were still in business, with the same Director and, later realised, an electrician of the old crew. I did receive a few quotes from other installers to cross check the situation and at the end had no hesitation to proceed with the offer from AHE Group. A long-established Company is no doubt a very good indicator of professionalism and commitment.I discussed a couple of alternatives with Andrew (the Director) and agreed to a solution just after the NSW Government decided to withdraw funding for the batteries rebate.As soon the Contract was signed, I was given the installation date of 15 August. Despite the crappy weather we had in Sydney for the last few weeks, they confirmed the installation day 48 hours in advance. I was really surprised because it was really raining a lot during the prior days.On the installation day I was working from home as I was very interested in following the steps of the installation and the approach in general. It did go as I remember went the first installation: a dedicated group in charge of the panels (removal of the old and install of the new) a second with the battery and a third with the switchboard.Andrew came early on to define the location for the panels and the battery and make sure everything was at hand. The crew was managed by Sam every time it was necessary but were mostly self-sufficient. Sam also tried hard and succeeded to embed all the wiring within the double brick cavity, so in the end the installation looked very, very nice. Managing a thick 3x16 + 1x6mm2 cable is difficult in these cavities. To my engineering mind, the work was above level in all aspects, from using the right tools, materials and methods to the finishing presentation.At the end, when the crew was cleaning and packing all the leftovers and rubbish, Andrew came back to check and certify the installation. I had no doubt that everything was in order as I followed the process during the day. Everything was OK first go, with and almost ridiculous number of labels everywhere and with a new set of MCBs in the switchboard.I have many more details that I liked about the whole experience, but it may be too long to describe here.To conclude, I have no hesitation in recommending AHE Group because they were very good in all aspects of the solar installation.
Overall I was very happy. The install was quick and clean The staff were very friendly and professional. The only thing that I think could be improved is a quick explanation of the app.

I came across AHE Group through Solar Quotes, and they’ve been excellent to deal with from start to finish. Andrew, the owner, along with his wife Leeanne and their children, work seamlessly as a team, which is fantastic to see. From quoting through to supply and installation, the process was handled efficiently and with great competence. I was initially concerned about the risk of cracking old terracotta tiles during installation, but after several weeks of heavy rain, everything has held up perfectly. Hopefully, it continues to remain leak-free and performing well.

The quotation process with AHE group was very informative and I could tell from the start that they had a lot of experience and a great straight forward, honest and professional attitude. The willingness to listen to what my requirements where and ongoing consultation on the system that we planned to install was second to none.On the day of installation, they were punctual, polite and tidy. At the end of the install my expectations were met and once again the professional work that was done was very impressive.The system has only been in place now for a couple of weeks, but we are very happy with the performance so far and the ongoing customer service is great as they are easy to contact and answer any questions that I have.AHE where also organized the grid connection with my electricity provider.Overall, I am very confident to suggest anybody that is looking to have a solar system installed that they could not find a better installer than AHE group.

Andrew and the team were a pleasure to deal with. Honest and transparent during the quoting process and very patient in explaining all the options and how everything works. Installation was pain free, everyone on site was super polite and the final product looks beautiful. Andrew took time at the end of installation to show me how everything works and AHE handled connection to the grid. I barely had to lift a finger and from day 1 I could see huge savings on the Sigenergy. Very happy I finally took the solar panel and battery plunge and I would highly recommend.

I recently had solar panels and a battery storage system installed at my home, and I couldn't be more impressed with the entire experience from start to finish. The team provided truly outstanding end-to-end service — professional, transparent, and highly efficient.From the initial consultation, I felt confident I was in good hands. They took the time to explain the options clearly, answered all my questions, and designed a custom solution that fit both my energy needs and budget. Their knowledge and honesty were refreshing, especially in a space where many providers seem to overpromise.The installation itself was smooth and expertly handled. The crew arrived on time, worked diligently, and showed great attention to detail. They were respectful of the property and left everything clean and tidy. The quality of workmanship was clearly top-tier.What really stood out to me was the follow-through after the installation. They guided me through system activation, monitoring, and rebates — and checked in afterward to ensure everything was working as expected. It’s rare to find such thorough customer care these days.Now, my system is running perfectly, and I’m already seeing a drop in my energy bills. If you're considering going solar, I highly recommend this AHE Group Pty Ltd  for a stress-free, end-to-end solar and battery installation. They delivered everything they promised — and then some.

Ahe Group is incredibly professional and friendly. They clearly know what they’re doing and carry out their work efficiently and without any issues. It’s been a pleasure working with such a capable and reliable team.

Couldn't be happier with AHE, Leeanne and Andrew were awesome to work with, were prompt and had all the answers.The installation went quick and they were very tidy and courteous when explaining the system and how it integrated.

As a licensed electrician, I have high standards when it comes to electrical work, and I can confidently say this solar installation company exceeded all my expectations. They were prompt, extremely clear in their communication, and their workmanship is truly exceptional. The entire team—Andrew, Sam, Anthony, and Majed—were fantastic, and I want to give a special mention to Leanne and Donna in the office for their support throughout the process. The finished job looks beautiful, and I’ll definitely be using them again and recommending them to everyone I know.Most importantly, they are owner operated, no sneaky sales tactics, no subcontractors that vanish afterwards. Highly recommended!
Andrew and his team installed panels and a battery for us. He recommended the best option for us. His communication was great and nothing was an issue. Site was left clean when finished.

I highly recommended this company. During installation there was a hiccup that damaged some of my electronics. I agree with them that this was a rare and unfortunate event.The reason I give them 5 stars is because the attitude of the entire staff, including Andrew, who apologised multiple times and refused to take any form of payments until everything is fixed. While my system is already up and running, they do not come and ask for payment until all my electronics are replaced as good as new.Mistakes can happen, but what is important is how they handle it, and I am thoroughly thankful for their ethics and honesty.I have not been incentivised for this review.

I talked to several solar and battery supplier/installers for quotations and most didn't have a good understanding of the systems they were selling, and even told me things I knew to be incorrect. AHE Group had been recommended to me and they gave me the most competitive price while also having great knowledge of the technology. Their install was of top quality, went smoothly, and they were friendly and obliging to deal with. They even painted over where the removal of equipment had exposed old paint!

AHE installed a 30 panel Jinko NEO array and a Sungrow inverter for half of the the price of their large competitors. Sam and the crew turned up on time and they only broke two roof tiles, which is exceptional in itself!The array is delivering exceptional performance and we're now wondering how to use all of the power that were generating.AHE are a small, family business that delivers a great product at an excellent price. I recommend Andrew, Sam and Leeanne to anyone looking for an excellent solar solution.

Andrew came out and give me a quote   The minute I saw him anll instantly liked him. He explained everything and I felt even more s when he mentioned that his son was part of the team.They arrived at 7.30am and worked quickly and methodically.When my son came over he could not believe how neat the job was.I am very pleased that we had picked such a hard working and component company.My wife and I highly recommend this company to do the job.

Andrew and his team far exceeded our expectations, they were all polite and friendly and very helpful answering all of our many questions. AHE Group price was competitive. Andrew's install team which included Andrew's son and himself and no subcontractors, did a very professional installation job of a roof solar system and battery at our home. All the joining cables were hidden, they arrived on time, finished on time, they were very tidy and cleaned up at the end of the day. We would have no hesitation in recommending AHE Group to do your solar or battery installation.Simon & JudyKellyville

I've just had a battery and more solar added to my house, after I used AHE originally 8 years ago. They replaced my original SMA inverter on warranty after part of it broke back in 2019.Installation was prompt and courteous. Andrew came back twice in two days to sort out a couple of issues commissioning the battery to our 3 phase supply and aircon.Customer service with Donna and the rest of the team has been very prompt.I've used them twice now and would recommend them to others.
Great local solar installer and nothing was a hassle. Recommend them for solar panels and batteries.

AHE installed our first PV installation in 2009. The system performed fault free from installation until replacement by AHE in early December 2024.In 2022 we purchased a Mitsubishi PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid EV), and the imminent replacement of our gas hot water system with a heat pump HWS will complete the conversion of our home to fully electric.The notional 5.7kW capacity of our original PV installation was not matching our increased electricity demands. Based on our experience with AHE, AHE was the ONLY installer we considered once we had decided to upgrade to a 12.3kW Enphase microinverter solution. AHE completed the installation by 1pm on the scheduled date. Some members of the AHE team were part of the team that completed our 2009 installation. As anticipated, the installation work was immaculate, and the system was online when the team departed. System performance has exceeded my expectations with December midday generation routinely peaking at 9.9kW.The attached images show the system's performance on 21Dec24 (longest day of the year) with some car charging and air conditioning demands. The other image shows the performance on 1Jun25 (another full-sun day three weeks before the shortest day of the year). There was little demand on 1Jun25 because we were away from home.The system has 28 440W Trina panels. The panels are installed on a 24 degree pitched tile roof. 11 facing NW, 13 facing NE, and 4 facing SE.We are on an AGL fixed tariff of 47.5 cents per kWh, supply fee of 96.49 cents per day and feed-in tariff of 20 cents per kWh. We have received a credit each month that now totals $636.I am exceedingly satisfied with AHE and the system.

Quoting process was straightforward.Installation was punctual, professional and the site was left neat and tidy. They also replaced some cracked tiles they discovered while doing my installation Very happy they let me know, and I supplied new tiles.Apps and smart meters were all set up with myself and the Energy Australia.
Was very with the team at AHE, very transparent process throughout and excellent job, especially happy with the electrical work.
From the very start Leeane, Andrew and their team are very easy to talk with. Excellent communication and knowledge made this whole challenging process a walk in the park.

Had been considering solar for a while but thought that the main part of my NW facing ground storey roof would be unsuitable due to  the shade of a large tree during the afternoon.As a result of a cold call door knock I received one quote from another supplier for a 4kW system with a very large price tag that would lock me into a 10 year payment plan.I thought that there had to be a better solution.After signing up to Solar Quotes I received a quote from AHE Solar for an 8 kW system with better panels and a better inverter for less cost than the first quoteAndrew was very knowledgeable and willing to answer all my solar questions and provide advice on the best solar configuration.  Leeanne and the admin team processed all the paperwork efficiently and professionally and guided me through the process that had to happen with my energy provider.Being a local operation, where they do their own installations, I have confidence that I will be well supported in the unlikely event of any problems.  I like the app that allows me to monitor the live solar performance data.In building the quote, Andrew suggested that problem caused by the shade on the lower roof could be solved by placing as many panels as possible on all 4 sections of the upper storey roof, a solution that I had not even considered was possible.That solution may not be able to have as many panels as first hoped, but by specifying a higher quality panel and micro inverters the system capacity would be sufficient to provide an attractive payback period.On the day of installation, the crew came prepared with extra panels in case they could “Tetris” more panels up there than what was on the original quote to provide the best possible solution.The installation was clean and efficient and the team were very good at keeping me informed of their progress and consulted with me to work out the best options for placement of the control box and the cabling.My most recent power bill arrived at the start of May.  The system was installed on 7th April.  The billing period ended 30th April. For the 23 days of solar across an 89 day billing period, my quarterly bill was $200 less than the prior quarter.I’m very happy with that result, especially since this time of year does not provide the ideal sun inclination for best solar generation.  Am looking forward to summer to see the increased performance. With numbers like that we look to be on track for a 2.5 - 3 year payback.

Andrew and his crew were exceptional in their punctuality and their workmanship.I was afforded the absolute best price for a fantastic solar system that fell within my budget. The entire team was extremely professional and well presented.  My installation was definitely challenging being a two story house with an old trimdeck almost flat roof.Nothing was a problem to this company.AHE Group is a family owned business so that in itself speaks volumes.I had been considering solar for quite a while but when I personally witnessed them installing a system across the road I went to my neighbour to enquire about who he used and his experience...He said from start to finish the whole experience was flawless.No rubbish left and a clean site.I personally would recommend Andrew and AHE Group to anybody that wants to talk to me about my new solar system...Thank YouGary

I had an excellent experience with AHE Group from start to finish. From the moment I reached out, I felt like part of the family. Andrew, the boss, was incredibly attentive to all my questions and made sure I felt confident every step of the way—like a mate looking out for you. Leanne from the office was extremely helpful, professional, and always available to assist with anything I needed, making the whole process feel personal and stress-free. The installation crew did an outstanding job—efficient, tidy, and clearly experienced, while still friendly and approachable. The whole team worked together like a close-knit family, and that energy really flowed through the whole project. The customer service and workmanship were top-notch. I highly recommend AHE Group to anyone considering solar—reliable, genuine, and a truly smooth process from beginning to end.
From the initial quote to the intallation and set up, it was fast and hassel free. Andrew and Leeanne arranged everything.

From start to finish, AHE has been a pleasant company to deal with. We had a quote process start the moment I sent out a request to get one. They were happy to communicate via SMS, email, and phone when required.Some of the other quotes I received didn't have anyone directly contact me, other than some automated messaging. Furthermore, there wasn't always an offer to come take a look at my roof, which is pretty important for solar. Leanne from AHE was a direct contact with me, helping arrange a time to have someone actually come down and take a look—and even assess if solar wouldn't work for us (due to possible shading). After looking at my electricity bills, she even gave some initial and sensible suggestions. She found a suitable time to have someone come around.However, I was happy to get a call from Andrew, who happened to be travelling past our neighbourhood (having finished with an installation). He offered to come around sooner than arranged, if it suited me. I invited him over and he gave what felt like some honest advice and feedback on what we were thinking. He viewed the roof from multiple angles and made some knowledgeable guesses on how much sunlight we'd get in different seasons based on the trees and houses that surrounded us. He showed us examples of similar installations and how effective they could be for us. He was very open to answering any questions we had. He gave us more information about his company and explained who was involved in the installation—making it clear his team were people he knew and trusted. I was surprised and relieved to learn he would also be involved in doing the installation. I was used to only having sales or consultants initially come around to the house.After Andrew's site visit, he sent through a detailed Pylon quote via email. We were extremely happy with the quote offered. Based on the comparison data on solarquotes.com.au, we knew it was reasonable. So other than price, the top-quality equipment choices they proposed, and the other positive reviews the company had, we decided to go with AHE because they genuinely felt like a good company full of people who wanted to work with us.On the day of the installation, I met all the people involved and let them get on with their respective jobs. As expected, Andrew was on-site to explain the process and discuss anything that might have needed confirmation. Despite a bit of wet weather, they did what looked to me like a professional job. The inverter and my existing mains box looks neat and tidy. And the panels look very nice on the roof, especially with the colour that Andrew suggested.Within minutes of everything being wired up, Andrew had the inverter communicating with the phone app and I could see power already going into the house. I was excited about the fact we were getting more power than I expected on a wet and overcast day.Overall, I'm extremely happy with having AHE do our solar.

I really liked that they went to considerable lengths to install the panels in the optimum locations. Also, they noticed that one panel had a hairline crack and came back the next day with a replacement panel.They also answered my after-instalments questions readily.

Andrew and the team were great to deal with. He answered all the questions I had and was happy to discuss options that suited us best. The install team turned up on time and were very professional and thorough with the install. System is working great and looks good on the roof. Thoroughly recommend using AHE.
Excellent to deal with, turned up on time did everything I asked for, gave me exceptional advice and did a great job, would recommend to everyone. Great price, quality product, quality install

From the get go both Leanne and Andrew were super helpful and offered excellent advice. They spoke in terms I was able to follow and understand unlike competitors.They were prompt with their quote and pleased to answer any questions I had. Once we were ready to go ahead it was a smooth process and come install day everything ran smoothly. Andrew and the team went above and beyond. We are very happy with our new system. A big thank you to the whole team. I would have no hesitation recommending their services to friends and family.

We had our system installed over a year ago now with excellent results. Our whole experience with Paul, Leeanne, Andrew and the team has been nothing short of brilliant. When we were comparing quotes at the start, Paul was extremely helpful in making us understand the intricacies of Solar. He always quickly replied to any queries we had. The installation was very smooth and the post installation support has been exceptional. Their quote for our system was extremely competitive given the quality of equipment used for our install. We didn't want low quality and are extremely happy we went with AHE Solar and their solution.

The quote was fair, the installation on time, the installers polite, experienced and quite efficient.They showed me around the system.They answered all my questions. After sales they were obliging when I had to remove some of the panels to fix the roof and reinstalling them back.

The quoting process with AHE Group Pty Ltd was excellent. We were provided with alternate quotes to suit our needs, and everything was explained clearly and thoroughly. All questions were answered promptly, and communication throughout was professional and responsive.The installation went smoothly. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and left the working area clean and tidy. They were polite and respectful throughout the process.Customer service was also excellent. AHE Group helped organise the grid connection and made sure we understood how to operate the system after installation.Overall, a professional and well managed experience from start to finish.
Two boys from AHE came, explained what they were doing, how they would route the cables, finished their work on time and left our home clean and tidy.

I bought a solar system from AHE Group Pty Ltd a few months ago and could not be happier. The whole process was seamless - from the initial quote/advice/Q&A phase all the way to the installation and post installation support. Really apreciate the fact Paul was always one phone call/message away (sometimes even on weekends) to answer all my questions and provide advice without me feeling being pressured into something. Guys who came to install the system were very polite and proffesional. The system works exactly as I was told and I love the enphase monitoring app that came with my micro invertors. I would highly recommend going with AHE Group Pty Ltd to anyone who wants to have a good system with a high quality installation and all the support pre and post the installation.

The installation of these panels was straightforward from discussions of brands and capacity to reliability and cost. We were very pleased with all aspects of this work. We had an old small system on one roof that we wanted enlarged and renewed. The original system was great for that time and it was a Tier 1 system so we knew what we wanted and were aware of most aspects. The discussion we had with AHE built further knowledge and was instrumental in obtaining a large efficient rooftop bank of panels with a Tier 1 inverter.AHE installed the system knowing our terracotta tiled roof would need spare tiles which we had to obtain but they also brought more as a ‘just in case’ measure…they were needed. We are very appreciative of their professionalism and attention to detail in all areas. They cleaned up all areas organising everything to do with the new panels and removal of old including grid connection. We couldn’t be happier and have free power covering all our needs when the sun shines and most when the sun doesn’t too! We watch how power varies throughout the day and can anticipate usage as well.

We have used AHE Group twice. The first was back in 2014 and then again in 2024 with a replacement system. The old one worked perfectly, however, we had to replace our entire roof.When I mentioned we needed to take the old system off, the business contacted me and said it would make sense to install a new one.
